status: LOCKED from approved sample unless teacher explicitly requests redesign
page_rule: US Letter portrait; 1 page preferred, maximum 2 pages; whole question cards never split across printed pages
workspace: Blank white writing space; no ruled lines; no name/date underline rules. Approved doubled geometry: small 1.40in, medium 2.40in, large 3.60in, xlarge 4.80in, equation-response 1.10in.
alignment: compact exact section I-can Evidence Focus visible near top; individual questions do not show I-can/DOK/Mastery badges
caption_rule: No descriptive student-facing captions under graphs/tables/figures.
packaging_rule: Shared course-root CSS dependency; do not copy this stylesheet into the Performance Task/Quick Check resource root.
parallel_versions: Six complete forms per section, all inside ONE dashboard-compatible u{U}_{S}_quick_check.html. Do not create _v2 through _v6 files. Each form has a small Version 1-6 footer label and a hard print page break before the next form.
mathjax: Use the established course-wide dollar-delimiter contract: inlineMath = $ / $, displayMath = $$ / $$, processEscapes true, async tex-mml-chtml.js. This must match the Framework finalizer and MathJax repair tool.
single_html_markup: Use six complete .quick-check.qc-version form blocks (or equivalent) in the one HTML. Each remains a standalone printable check.
